# Todo UI Generation Implementation Plan

> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

**Goal:** Make the to-do example render from data through the staged `Data -> SemanticUI -> GeometricUI -> ConcreteUI` pipeline.

**Architecture:** Data creates the semantic tree. Lazy semantic children are generated by `describe_children`. Semantic-to-geometric `describe` methods only lower existing semantic nodes. Geometric containers implicitly convert semantic children with `convert(GeometricUI, child)`.

**Tech Stack:** Julia, Prospects.jl `@def`/`@property`, UI.jl `SemanticUI`/`GeometricUI`, MiniFB, Font.jl units, Rutherford tests.

---

### Task 2: Implement Semantic Child Adoption And Geometric Conversion

**Files:**
- Modify: `Interface/abstract.jl`
- Test: `Interface/abstract_test.jl`

**Step 1: Fix lazy child adoption**

In `adopt!(parent::UITree, children)`, replace the undefined `ui` references with `parent`:

```julia
adopt!(parent::UITree, children) = begin
  lastchild = nothing
  for child in children
    setfield!(child, :parent, parent)
    if isnothing(lastchild)
      setfield!(parent, :firstchild, child)
    else
      setfield!(lastchild, :nextsibling, child)
      setfield!(child, :prevsibling, lastchild)
    end
    lastchild = child
  end
  parent
end
```

**Step 2: Add implicit semantic-to-geometric conversion**

Near the existing `describe` generic and `describe!` helper, add:

```julia
Base.convert(::Type{GeometricUI}, node::GeometricUI) = node
Base.convert(::Type{GeometricUI}, node::SemanticUI) = begin
  result = describe(node)
  result.from = node
  result
end
```

Then keep `describe!` as a compatibility wrapper:

```julia
describe!(node::SemanticUI) = convert(GeometricUI, node)
```

**Step 3: Teach geometric containers to adopt semantic children**

Add the more-specific mixin method after `GeometricUI` exists:

```julia
mixin!(r::GeometricUI, d::SemanticUI) =
  add_child!(r, convert(GeometricUI, d))
```

Keep the existing generic `mixin!(r::UITree, d::UITree)` for semantic-parent-to-semantic-child adoption and explicit geometric children.

**Step 4: Run the focused test**

Run: `julia Interface/abstract_test.jl`

Expected: PASS.

**Step 5: Run existing layout tests**

Run: `julia Interface/Specific/test.jl`

Expected: PASS.

```bash

git commit -m "feat: lower semantic children in geometric containers"
```

### Task 3: Rewrite The Todo Example Around The Staged Semantic Tree

**Files:**
- Modify: `examples/22_todo_list.jl`

**Step 1: Define semantic nodes without app back-references**

Use this semantic layer:

```julia
@def mutable struct TodoApp <: SemanticUI
  todos::Vector{TodoItem} = TodoItem[]
  filter::Symbol = :all
end

@def mutable struct TodoTitle <: SemanticUI end
@def mutable struct TodoComposer <: SemanticUI end
@def mutable struct TodoFilters <: SemanticUI end
@def mutable struct FilterTab <: SemanticUI
  mode::Symbol = :all
end
@def mutable struct TodoList <: SemanticUI end
@def mutable struct TodoRow <: SemanticUI
  index::Int
end
@def mutable struct DeleteBtn <: SemanticUI end
@def mutable struct TodoFooter <: SemanticUI end
```

**Step 2: Add local parent traversal helpers**

```julia
todo_app(node::SemanticUI) = begin
  current = node
  while current !== nothing
    current isa TodoApp && return current
    current = current.parent
  end
  error("node is not inside a TodoApp")
end

todo_item(row::TodoRow) = todo_app(row).todos[row.index]
```

**Step 3: Generate semantic children only in data-to-semantic methods**

```julia
describe(items::Vector{TodoItem}) =
  TodoApp(todos=items,
    TodoTitle(),
    TodoComposer(TextInput(placeholder="What needs to be done?")),
    TodoFilters(),
    TodoList(),
    TodoFooter())

describe_children(::TodoFilters) =
  [FilterTab(mode=:all), FilterTab(mode=:active), FilterTab(mode=:done)]

describe_children(list::TodoList) =
  map(i -> TodoRow(index=i), visible_indexes(todo_app(list)))

describe_children(row::TodoRow) = begin
  item = todo_item(row)
  [
    Checkbox(checked=item.done, onchange=c -> item.done = c.checked),
    DeleteBtn()
  ]
end
```

**Step 4: Preserve index-based filtering**

```julia
visible_indexes(app::TodoApp) =
  app.filter == :all ? collect(eachindex(app.todos)) :
  app.filter == :active ? filter(i -> !app.todos[i].done, eachindex(app.todos)) :
  filter(i -> app.todos[i].done, eachindex(app.todos))
```

**Step 5: Lower semantic nodes without creating semantic nodes**

In each `describe(::SemanticUI)` method, consume existing children:

```julia
describe(app::TodoApp) = begin
  title, composer, filters, list, footer = app.children
  Column(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(grow=GrowType.Grow),
         padding(24px), background(colorant"rgb(246,247,251)"),
    title,
    Box(height(14px)),
    composer,
    Box(height(18px)),
    filters,
    Box(height(14px)),
    list,
    footer)
end

describe(c::TodoComposer) = begin
  input = c.firstchild
  Row(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(42px),
    Box(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(grow=GrowType.Grow), input))
end

describe(f::TodoFilters) = begin
  all, active, done = f.children
  Row(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(30px),
    all, Box(width(8px)), active, Box(width(8px)), done)
end

describe(l::TodoList) = begin
  rows = Any[]
  for (i, row) in enumerate(l.children)
    i > 1 && push!(rows, Box(height(8px)))
    push!(rows, row)
  end
  Column(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(grow=GrowType.Grow), rows...)
end

describe(r::TodoRow) = begin
  checkbox, delete = r.children
  item = todo_item(r)
  Row(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(42px), padding(10px),
      radius(8px), background(colorant"white"),
      border(1px, :solid, colorant"rgb(226,232,240)"),
    checkbox,
    Box(width(12px)),
    Box(width(grow=GrowType.Grow), height(22px),
      Text(item.text, size=13pt,
           color=item.done ? colorant"rgb(148,163,184)" : colorant"rgb(30,41,59)")),
    delete)
end
```

Keep `describe(::TodoTitle)`, `describe(::FilterTab)`, `describe(::DeleteBtn)`, and `describe(::TodoFooter)` similarly geometric-only: they may create `Box`, `Row`, `Column`, and `Text`, but no `SemanticUI` nodes.

**Step 6: Keep behavior existing-style and minimal**

Do not add `interpret`. Keep existing `onkey` handlers only as needed:

```julia
onkey(b::DeleteBtn, ::KeyPress{Keys.mouse_left}) = begin
  row = b.parent::TodoRow
  deleteat!(todo_app(row).todos, row.index)
end

onkey(t::FilterTab, ::KeyPress{Keys.mouse_left}) =
  todo_app(t).filter = t.mode
```

If Enter-to-add is kept, resolve the input through the semantic tree instead of an `app.input` field.

**Step 7: Commit**

```bash
git add examples/22_todo_list.jl
git commit -m "example: stage todo ui generation"
```
